retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, impasto-style painted portrait on a distressed canvas texture with bold, flat-color typography overlaid.

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, expressive oil-painted portrait of a male figure with a pompadour hairstyle, characterized by heavy brushstrokes and high-contrast lighting. The image features a prominent canvas weave texture and a distressed, aged border, with a single pop of vibrant red typography positioned on the left side.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subject against a dark, textured background
Vibrant red typography contrasting with the grayscale palette
Heavy impasto brushwork defining facial features and hair
Asymmetrical composition with the subject's gaze directed toward the viewer
coreInvariants: Visible canvas weave texture across the entire image
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights
Distressed, worn edges suggesting a vintage physical object

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly angled.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright highlight on the forehead/nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red text on the left, moves across to the subject's eyes, then follows the hair's curve.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, painterly space on the left side provides a backdrop for the primary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (Black, White, and various grays) for the portrait and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks for shadow depth and canvas texture definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant, saturated Red for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; zero saturation in the image except for the text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on the impact of the condensed block shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface for maximum impact against the complex painted background.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Captures the clean, tall, mid-century sans-serif look.
Offers various condensed weights suitable for vintage posters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic oil painting of a male face with a 1950s pompadour. Use heavy impasto brushstrokes and visible canvas texture. Ensure the left side has a dark, painterly area for text placement. Add a distressed, worn-edge border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay bold, extra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text in a vibrant red color on the left side. Align the text to the left and stack the words vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the canvas texture clearly visible?
Is the text a bold, condensed red sans-serif?
Does the image have a distressed vintage border?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the text
mustRedesign: Do not use clean, non-textured backgrounds
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Verify the distressed border looks organic
Confirm the high-contrast lighting is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast impasto portrait + Canvas texture + Bold red condensed sans-serif = Mid-century gritty aesthetic.
